message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Milestones 1+2 complete in src/cachetools/tagged.py. TaggedCache(maxsize) is backed by cachetools.LRUCache (private _TaggedLRUCache reports evicted keys so tag state is cleaned on eviction). R01: put() deep-copies values on input, get() returns detached deep copy / KeyError on miss, tags validated as finite iterable of strings (bare str and non-str entries raise ValueError before any mutation), deduplicated. R02: invalidate(tag) exact removal with count, replacement swaps tag memberships, eviction leaves no stale memberships, get() refreshes recency, len() counts live entries. R03: maxsize positive non-bool int, invalid replacement input leaves value/tags/recency unchanged, one slot per value. Claim-A: put overwriting an existing key refreshes LRU recency (MRU). R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any') - 'any' removes union, 'all' removes entries with every tag, empty tags remove zero in both modes, returns distinct removed keys, invalid mode/tags rejected before mutation. R05: resize(maxsize) validates positive non-bool int first (failed resize preserves all state), shrinking evicts LRU, growing evicts nothing, survivors keep values/tags/LRU order, maxsize property reports current capacity (old design notes 'empty all-tags matches every key' and 'resizing may flush' explicitly superseded). R06: generator tags accepted and consumed exactly once (counting-generator test), values detached across repeated gets/puts including nested lists/dicts. Verified: acceptance_public.py 3/3 passed (incl. test_public_union_resize), own tests 43/43 passed, full suite tests/ + acceptance_public.py = 259 passed 0 failed; upstream test files unchanged (git status shows only new files). HANDOFF.md updated.","completion_asserted":true}
